title: Robust Task-Aware State Estimation from Pre-trained Perception
abstract: arXiv:2611.14781v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents that perform state estimation using pretrained perception models, e.g., Vision-Language Models (VLMs), face the fundamental challenge that predictions are uncertain. Still, most approaches determinize these predictions into a single best-guess state and make decisions as if it were ground truth. This is brittle because when the guess is wrong, the agent's decisions may be unsafe or infeasible. At the other extreme, maintaining a full probability distribution over symbolic states is often intractable. We propose a middle path, drawing on the underlying probabilities the perception model already produces (e.g., a VLM's output-layer token distributions) to construct a $\theta$-confidence Minimal Belief Set (MBS$_\theta$), a minimal subset of states whose cumulative probability meets a user-specified belief-mass threshold. translated_title: 基于预训练感知的鲁棒任务感知状态估计
translated_abstract: 使用预训练感知模型（例如视觉-语言模型VLM）执行状态估计的智能体面临着一个根本性挑战：预测是不确定的。然而，大多数方法将这些预测确定化为单一的最佳猜测状态，并把它当作真实值来进行决策。这种做法很脆弱，因为一旦猜测错误，智能体的决策可能是不安全的或不可行的。而在另一个极端，维护符号状态上的完整概率分布往往是难以处理的。我们提出了一条中间路线：利用感知模型本身已经产生的底层概率（例如VLM输出层的token分布）来构建θ置信度最小信念集（MBS_θ），即一个累积概率满足用户指定信念质量阈值的状态最小子集。MBS_θ的最小性确保智能体只需考虑最可能的状态，从而增强鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出利用预训练感知模型输出的概率分布构建θ置信度最小信念集（MBS_θ），在单一最佳猜测与完整概率分布之间取得平衡，让智能体只考虑最可能的状态，从而提升决策的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Proposes constructing a θ-confidence Minimal Belief Set (MBS_θ) from the probability distributions produced by pre-trained perception models, striking a balance between a single best guess and a full probability distribution so that agents consider only the most likely states to enhance decision robustness.
